{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.62

|gr1= Campaign

|serverExec= server

|descr= Sets skill for an entire AI side. The skill will be calculated using a lerp function. Function will take player as multiplier.

|s1= [side,skillMin,skillAimMin,skillMax,skillAimMax] call [[BIS_fnc_EXP_camp_setSkill]]

|p1= side: [[Side]] - side of which AI skill should be changed
|p2= skillMin: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0.5) minimal general skill
|p3= skillAimMin: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0.3) minimal aiming skill
|p4= skillMax: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0.8) maximal general skill
|p5= skillAimMax: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0.5) maximal aiming skill

|r1=

|x1=<sqf>[WEST,0.1,0.2,0.7,0.6] call BIS_fnc_EXP_camp_setSkill;</sqf>

|seealso= [[Arma 3: AI Skill]] [[setSkill]] [[skillFinal]] [[BIS_fnc_EXP_camp_dynamicAISkill]]
